scope: One disposable Kubernetes v1.36.1 cluster. A real OCI registry stores an inert model by manifest and blob digest. Separate publisher and organization OpenSSL Jobs generate ephemeral keys and sign the identical model bytes. An independent verifier checks those signatures before a digest-bound immutable promotion record is written. Native admission uses that record to gate a model consumer Pod. The allowed Pod fetches and checks exact registry bytes. A supplemental non-signing verifier reads an immutable, separately named organization trust ConfigMap and verifies the signature over the exact fixture model; a publisher key and changed bytes are rejected. The trust ConfigMap is still created by the test harness from the synthetic signer result. Production key custody, independently governed trust configuration, registry identity, signer authority, namespace coverage, and policy enrollment remain open.

checks.claim: The organization signer rejects the exact model until approval is present
The exact upstream-only signed model request is admitted before the promotion control
Independent verification accepts both correct signatures and rejects the wrong trust key and changed model
A separate verifier loads an explicit immutable organization trust config and rejects publisher-key or changed-content substitution
The exact pre-control upstream-only declaration receives the named admission denial
Kubernetes rejects the approved digest with the publisher key fingerprint
Kubernetes rejects a mismatched consumer registry manifest even with the correct recorded signer
The organization-signed declaration is admitted and consumes the exact registry artifact
